sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this case is a purely family dispute and only reason for filing the FIR is that the complainant want her husband to stay with her and therefore,
the FIR is lodged with some false and concocted allegation.

Considering the nature of accusation and the punishment prescribed for the same, this Court finds that this is a fit case where the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail can be extended to the petitioner.

Accordingly, in the event of the arrest of the petitioner, namely, Mukti Md. Talukdar @ Jitu Talukdar in connection Rangia P.S. Case No. 0744/2022 under Section 498A/406 IPC, he shall be released on interim pre-arrest bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.20,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.

The above privilege is, however, subject to the following conditions:-
(1) The petitioner shall appear before the I.O. of the case as and when called/summoned for the investigation;
(2) The petitioner shall not tamper with the evidence of the prosecution witnesses or the investigating agency;
and Page No.# 3/3 (3) The petitioner shall not indulge in the commission of the offence which is alleged against him and any violation of the aforesaid conditions shall automatically lead to cancellation of the bail.
Call for the Case Diary.
List the matter again on 21.02.2023.
JUDGE
